display_long_description:
Step behind the bar in Last Call, a cozy VR tavern sim for Meta Quest 3. You're the barkeep for the evening.  Customers arrive with orders and it's up to you to pour the right drinks, mix in the right syrups, and serve them before the night is over.
Nail the perfect pour to earn maximum coins. Too little and you'll disappoint. Too much and you've wasted a good drink. Get it just right and the coins fly.

Customers call out their orders in voices and react to your service. Pour a perfect drink and they're delighted. Mess it up and they'll let you know.

When the bar quiets down, step over to the dartboard. Physics-based throwing mechanics let you line up and throw for coin rewards between orders.

Features:
Multiple drink and syrup combinations
AI customer voices with dynamic reactions
Physics-based dart throwing
Warm stylized tavern environment
Coin economy with per-shift scoring
Built for Meta Quest 3
